text:
Elena: Quick thread 15 planning DP/beta for Route Optimizer (routing policy + cost-tiering). Need recruitment criteria, bare-min scope, success metrics, and rollback plan for tomorrows roadmap sync. Target 6-9 partners, 4-week pilot.
Ravi: Ops constraints: must be hosted or VPC only. No onprem. Need per-org model budget, route-level feature flagging, and a safe rollback that flips traffic back to current optimizer within 2 mins.
Jo: Feedback plan: ask each partner for a 30-example gold prompt set + 5 high-risk edge cases. We'll run nightly regressions and surface a weekly "quality delta". Also want a quick feedback form in the console for triage notes.
Carlos: Recruitment: pick teams with known cost concerns or multi-region routing needs. Incentive: $1000 credits + customized cost-savings estimate, plus a technical debrief. Screen: legal readiness and ability to share anonymized telemetry. Avoid fintech/healthcare this round.
Elena: Scope negotiation: promise routing policy editor UI (basic), route-level rollouts, telemetry for cost/latency, and an exportable eval. Do not promise custom kernel changes, model retraining, or infra changes.
Ravi: Implementation note: feature flag will be per-route and toggled in control plane. We'll add an automated smoke test after enable; if p95 latency jumps >25% we flip. ops-bot will post when configs change.
Jo: Success metrics draft:
- Activation: 60% partners enable within 7 days
- Cost impact: median token-cost reduction >=8% across partners
- Quality: <12% of partners show >5% drop in quality on baseline eval
- Commercial signal: at least 2 partners request roadmap commitment or dedicated capacity
Carlos: Add a buy-in metric: 30% of partners schedule a follow-up deep-dive with eng within 2 weeks of pilot end.
Elena: Onboarding checklist: kickoff (45m), sample prompts, telemetry keys (request_id, route_id, cost_usd, tokens, duration_ms), intake form. Draft intake fields minimal: org, contact, use_case, current_token_cost/month, can_share_prompts (y/n), preferred_deploy(hosted/vpc).
Ravi: Action items:
- Ravi: implement per-route flag + auto-revert smoke test (ETA: EOD)
- Jo: prepare eval template and feedback form prototype (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- Carlos: outreach list and incentive copy (3-5 targets) (ETA: today EOD)
- Elena: slide for roadmap sync and pilot brief (ETA: tomorrow)
ops-bot: config-deploy: route-optimizer-pilot-flags v1 deployed (status: success)
Elena: Good. If nobody objects to no-onprem and the incentive level, I'll lock this and start outreach. :rocket:
